Mario identity, mode usage, callback-field meanings and delegated engine effects require family evidence.
facts.rationale: Restrict inherited claim to canonical local behavior and registration; defer foreign semantics.

evidence.why: Canonical body proves local behavior.
Canonical descriptor, callback rows and target initializer establish local registration.
